claims.text: Barcelona’s records distinguish city eligibility lists from Philip’s later reservation of inclusion and removal powers. Marseille’s municipal account describes Louis XIV intervening against its first consul and reallocating municipal power. Crown allegiance does not specify identical selection rights. Neither elite ballots nor the royal intervention represents all residents’ consent; the two institutions and source levels remain distinct.
